frozen_before: Reference scoring of generated ensembles; generation and native reconstruction diagnostics already executed
scope: Development diagnostic; no promotion from dispersion or oracle nearest-reference quality alone
state_features: Common observed CA positions; sequence separation >3; reference distance range >=2 A and minimum distance <=12 A. No generated coordinates enter feature selection.
state_merging: Connected components of reference feature RMSE <=1 A; multiple crystallographic copies cannot count as distinct states
state_assignment: Nearest reference feature vector; assigned component only if feature RMSE <= threshold, maximum reference CA lDDT >=0.8 and coarse-valid geometry. All generated samples retained in denominators.
md_distribution: Published 2D projections; mean one-dimensional Wasserstein distance across 64 fixed angles, all generated samples and reference projections. No alignment or fitted parameters from generated samples.
controls: NMR is a low experimental-model dispersion control, not a population reference. Report generated/reference dispersion and nearest-reference quality without counting NMR models as states.
statistics: One family per target; paired comparisons and family bootstrap. Seeds are repeated measurements. Feature-poor or single-state cases reported explicitly, excluded only from multistate state-coverage denominators.
